label: Coaching / Tuition Centre
description: Tuition classes, test-prep institutes, skill academies, language and music schools.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Parents shortlist on recent, specific reviews. Admission season swings hard on the last 60 days of proof.

issueTaxonomy.label: Teaching quality / doubt clearing
issueTaxonomy.action: Add a fixed weekly doubt-clearing slot per batch and record attendance of the faculty member who takes it.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the teaching not being what you expected

issueTaxonomy.label: Teachers changed mid-course
issueTaxonomy.action: Commit the named faculty per batch in writing at admission, and inform parents in advance of any change.

issueTaxonomy.label: Batch too large / no attention
issueTaxonomy.action: Cap the batch size you advertise and stop admitting past that cap, even in season.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the batch being too large for proper attention
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: batch bade hone se dhyan na milne
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseMarathi: बॅच मोठा असल्याने लक्ष न दिल्याबद्दल

issueTaxonomy.label: Fee / refund disputes
issueTaxonomy.action: Give every parent a written fee and refund schedule at admission, and stop collecting anything not on that sheet.

issueTaxonomy.label: Poor communication with parents
issueTaxonomy.action: Send a fixed monthly progress note per student and hold one parent meeting per term.

issueTaxonomy.label: Classes cancelled or rescheduled
issueTaxonomy.action: Publish the term timetable up front and give 24-hour notice for any change, with a make-up slot.

issueTaxonomy.label: Results not as promised
issueTaxonomy.action: Remove every result claim you cannot evidence, and never promise a rank, score or selection.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the results not matching what was promised
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: result waise na aane jaise kahe gaye the

issueTaxonomy.label: Classroom condition / facilities
issueTaxonomy.action: Fix the specific physical complaint named most often (fans, seating, washroom, light) before adding new batches.

issueTaxonomy.label: Study material quality / delays
issueTaxonomy.action: Hand over the full material set on day one of the batch, or state the delivery date in writing.

issueTaxonomy.label: Safety / discipline concerns
issueTaxonomy.action: Escalate offline immediately: handle privately with the parent before any public reply.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: concerns about how things are run

praiseTaxonomy.label: Strong teaching
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the teaching is working for you
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: padhai aapke liye kaam kar rahi hai

praiseTaxonomy.label: Individual attention
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: har student par alag dhyan diya gaya

praiseTaxonomy.label: Improvement in results
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the marks are moving in the right direction

staffAskScript.when: At the front desk or a parent meeting, for every parent — not only after good results.
staffAskScript.line: There is a QR at the desk. Tell us honestly how the classes are going for your child, including anything that is not working. It comes straight to us.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Desk par QR hai. Honestly bataiye classes aapke bacche ke liye kaisi chal rahi hain — jo theek nahi hai woh bhi. Seedha humein aata hai.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: डेस्कवर QR आहे. तुमच्या मुलासाठी वर्ग कसे चालले आहेत ते प्रामाणिकपणे सांगा — जे नीट नाही तेही. ते थेट आमच्याकडे येतं.
doNot: Never offer a fee discount, free test series or material in exchange for a review.
Never ask only the parents of high scorers.
Never write a review on a parent's phone.
Never ask anyone to remove or edit a review.
Never mention a student's name, marks or rank in a public reply.
Never wait until someone looks happy — offer the QR to everyone, every time.
Never ask a customer to leave a public review as a condition of anything.
